title: Validate the kit with an unrelated adopter
summary: Try the released ZIP in a project outside the template repository and record where the onboarding instructions or deliverable checks need clarification.

origin.source: Public Brand Identity Template source and release review

benefits: Separates real-world adoption feedback from the existing synthetic walkthrough.
risks: One adopter cannot establish compatibility for every project.

evidence.claim: The released smoke test covers a disposable repository and synthetic PNG assets.
